lines.en: A card from Jimmy
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.cn: 先听这段录音，然后再回答这个问题。

lines.en: Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
lines.cn: 奶奶收到吉米送的卡片时，看起来很高兴吗？为什么呢？

lines.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
lines.cn: 请把吉米的卡片内容读给我听，佩妮。

lines.en: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
lines.cn: 我刚到苏格兰，现在住在一家青年旅舍里。

lines.en: Eh?
He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
lines.cn: 他说他刚刚抵达苏格兰。

lines.en: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
lines.cn: 他说他现在住在一家青年旅舍里。

lines.en: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
lines.cn: 你知道他是 Y.H.A. 的成员。

lines.en: The what?
The Y.H.A., Mum.
The Youth Hostels Association.
What else does he say?
'I'll write a letter soon.
I hope you are all well.'
lines.cn: 我希望你们大家都一切都好。

lines.en: What? Speak up, Penny.
I'm afraid I can't hear you.
He says he'll write a letter soon.
lines.cn: 他说他很快就会写一封信。

lines.en: He hopes we are all well.
lines.cn: 他希望我们所有人都安好。

lines.en: 'Love, Jimmy.'
Is that all?
He doesn't say very much, does he?
He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
lines.cn: 妈妈，他在卡片上写不了太多内容。
